title: Bee Removal in Bedford, Westchester
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Bedford, Westchester. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, soffits, eaves, and ground burrows. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal throughout Bedford, Westchester. Our licensed technicians locate and treat nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, chimneys, eaves, wood siding, and ground burrows — protecting Bedford homes, estates, and commercial properties from aggressive stinging insects. We serve all of Bedford with fast response times and clear pricing confirmed on the call.
whyUs: Our team brings years of experience to Bedford's unique properties, from historic estates to modern homes, using safe removal techniques that protect both your family and the environment. We're fully licensed, insured, and available for emergency bee removal throughout Westchester County.
localContext: Bedford's wooded estates, historic properties along Route 22, and expansive residential areas near Bedford Village create ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets in chimneys, soffits, wall voids, and attic spaces. Carpenter bees tunnel into the cedar trim and deck posts common on Bedford's larger properties. From homes near the Mianus River Gorge to estates in Bedford Hills, wasp and hornet colonies build paper nests inside wall cavities and under eaves throughout the spring and summer, often going unnoticed until the nest blocks a vent or hundreds of workers defend the entry point.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Bedford?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — a ground yellow jacket nest is less complex than a hornet nest inside a second-story wall void or a soffit on one of Bedford's taller estates. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in Bedford?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Bedford and Westchester County. During peak spring and summer months, we prioritize calls when an active nest poses immediate risk to families or when workers are entering the structure.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Bedford?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What areas of Bedford do you service?
faqs.answer: We service all of Bedford including Bedford Village, Bedford Hills, Katonah, and surrounding Westchester areas. Our technicians are familiar with Bedford's mix of historic homes, modern estates, and commercial properties along Routes 22, 117, and 172.
